originality.rationale: PASS within examined statements. Nakano–Soma–Yamamoto (2022) already prove the existence of the wandering rectangles, exact geometric derivative products and an interval of pointwise finite-time Lyapunov accumulation values. Their Theorem 3.1 does not classify empirical probability laws over observation times; an accumulation interval alone mathematically cannot determine frequencies. A published November 1 related result determines coordinate-axis *Cesàro scalar averages* and a logarithmic regularization; its full RESULT was read and does not yield this probability-valued family as a stated implication. The new contribution is the complete one-parameter time-histogram weak-cluster family and rational CDF contrast, not the known derivative identities. This is a short deduction from strong prior input; other formulations in uninspected journal appendices and unindexed literature remain an explicit priority risk.

This is an independently useful invariant for the motivating example, despite being a specialized and relatively short calculation.
